{
 "path": "/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-openclaw-luna6-high-fresh0/frozen/seen-reference-3/play/users/u023/system/state/workspace/programs/task-7ad04219.py",
 "content": "from collections import Counter


def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Grid-wide solid lines are the panel separators.
    row_lines = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1]
    col_lines = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    line_colors = [grid[r][0] for r in row_lines] + [grid[0][c] for c in col_lines]
    sep = Counter(line_colors).most_common(1)[0][0]
    row_bounds = [-1] + row_lines + [h]
    col_bounds = [-1] + col_lines + [w]
    row_regions = [(row_bounds[i] + 1, row_bounds[i + 1]) for i in range(len(row_bounds) - 1)
                   if row_bounds[i + 1] > row_bounds[i] + 1]
    col_regions = [(col_bounds[i] + 1, col_bounds[i + 1]) for i in range(len(col_bounds) - 1)
                   if col_bounds[i + 1] > col_bounds[i] + 1]
    interior = [grid[r][c] for r0, r1 in row_regions for c0, c1 in col_regions
                for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1)]
    bg = Counter(interior).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out = [[bg for _ in col_regions] for _ in row_regions]
    for i, (r0, r1) in enumerate(row_regions):
        for j, (c0, c1) in enumerate(col_regions):
            markers = sum(grid[r][c] != bg and grid[r][c] != sep
                          for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1))
            if markers > 1:
                out[i][j] = 1
    return out
"
